Without Woo Yeonjae, there’s no one for me.
Someone other than me, whom Moon Seoyoon likes.
“I’d rather you like me. It’d be easier, then.”

81563.synopsis:
Isabella Dunkeld is a notorious evil woman, hated by her family and scorned by everyone. But things take a strange turn when a powerful demon lord from the demon realm finds herself trapped in her body.
‘How did I end up in this body?’ The demon has no memory of making a contract with Isabella, yet here she is, stuck and powerless. To avoid revealing her true identity, she must act as ‘human’ as possible.
“So, how many people have I killed with these hands? Hundreds? Thousands?”
“Um… you haven’t killed anyone.”
“Not a single person, yet they call me an evil woman?”
Humans are incomprehensible to the demon.
***
To complete the contract and escape Isabella’s body, the demon must fulfill her most fervent wish: ‘Make my family regret everything.’ With an indifferent father and a lunatic brother, the demon decides to get closer to these worthless family members.
“Hey, if you talk like that, you make us sound like tr*sh.”
“You are tr*sh. Reflect on that, tr*sh.”
Is this how it’s done?
associated_names: The Possessed Villainess Is Causing Trouble

82075.synopsis:
On Christmas Eve, amid snowfall, Xue Li received a call from Chun Xin. On the other end of the line, she heard Chun Xin’s quiet breathing and a whisper of her name.
“I’m sorry, I miss you…”
Amidst the noisy background, Xue Li couldn’t hear her. “I’m busy, I’ll call you back later,” she said.
After hanging up, and closing the car door, a gentle female voice on the radio murmured soothing words, reminding listeners to bundle up as the cold wave approached.
That winter was unusually cold, and after that call, Chun Xin’s phone was never reachable again. She often threw tantrums, but Xue Li didn’t pay much attention.
In March of the following year, Xue Li learned of Chun Xin’s passing. Her phone only held Xue Li’s number.
She secretly came to see her, staying in the simple self-built rental house behind the school. Chun Xin passed away from what the radio said was an exceptionally severe winter. Chun Xin had just turned seventeen that year.
On the way there, Xue Li saw buds sprouting on the trees lining the road, and when the wind blew, pink petals fluttered down.
Winter had passed, spring had come, and the radio host’s warm voice persisted. But Chun Xin was no longer there.
Ten years separated by life and death, Xue Li thought every day, “If only everything could start over, how wonderful it would be.”
She had everything they had once dreamed of together, but still couldn’t feel happiness, staring at the bleak ceiling, feeling emptiness beside her.
“If only everything could start over, how wonderful it would be.”

84635.synopsis:
#Esper #FatedLove #Misunderstanding #MemoryLoss #LowSelf-EsteemShou
At the moment Kim Hayun took his first breath after birth, Baek Mookyeong also drew his first breath in this world. It was difficult to pinpoint exactly when it happened, but both Kim Hayun and Baek Mookyeong felt their connection from that instant.
Bound by destiny, they shared every moment together. This intertwined life seemed perfectly natural to them.
***
On the day the [door] opened, Baek Mookyeong lost his memories while Kim Hayun lost his abilities. For Baek Mookyeong, who had lost his memories, there was only one certainty left: Kim Hayun could never be a piece of himself.
“I’m truly sorry for everything. So please, return him to me. Without him, I have nothing left. Absolutely nothing.”
“You, how much do you remember? How far back can you recall?”
Kim Hayun created the imaginary existence of Kim Heewon just to stay by Mookyeong’s side as a friend. However, Mookyeong misunderstood and believed that Hayun survived alone after losing Heewon.
“I will continue telling you about the things you have forgotten. In return, let’s be friends again.”
As Kim Hayun’s lies continued to grow, Baek Mookyeong’s resentment and hatred towards him increased.
“….Kim Hayun, you make me unhappy.”
Then at age 27, Kim Hayun promised to leave Baek Mookyeong behind.
“Mookyeong-ah, don’t remember anything. I ruined everything.”
Born as each other’s ‘pieces,’ but drifting apart, can these two individuals reach the ending they desired?

That is all a misunderstanding.

86427.synopsis:
A popular idol beauty needs to solve his susceptibility period, so he must secretly marry an omega at a hospital. However, the partner is far from his ideal type—not soft, not delicate, not charming.
The omega is tall, with long legs, broad chest, tan skin, and a buzz cut—an upstart who built his fortune from scratch at construction sites. Even his pheromones lack sweetness.
On the first day of marriage, Tan Da Mei Ren (Big Beauty Tan) set rules, disdainfully commenting on the other’s ordinary looks and the “vulgar” scent of a nouveau riche businessman: “You don’t deserve someone like me.”
Boss Xing lowered his head in shame: “Sorry.”
From then on, Boss Xing avoided appearing outside of his heat or susceptibility periods, fearing he would become a nuisance, implementing the marriage in name only.
Silent and reserved, the man carries out the formality of the marriage to the end.
Out of compensation, he buys a house for the Alpha and invests in his new film, all quietly, without showing his face, unwilling to be a burden.
Little did he know, Tan Mei Ren was going crazy!!
Can someone explain why every time his omega storms out after being bitten, he pulls up his pants and leaves without looking back? He doesn’t stay for even a second! Could it be that, despite his youth, he’s already losing his appeal? Or is the charm of his face diminishing?!
Meanwhile, the very person he despises, Boss Xing, is incredibly popular with business partners and close subordinates, all within arm’s reach.
Tan Mei Ren, comparing himself, says, “Hmph, why would I care about him?”
At night, he sneers at home, “You think finding someone for a scandal, playing hard to get, will catch my attention? Let me tell you, I’m not interested in you at all! You better not fall for me!”
Boss Xing: “I’m not…”
Tan Zhi Yu: “I don’t believe you.”
Boss Xing: “?”
They had agreed to a marriage without interference. Tan Zhi Yu couldn’t believe someone could resist his facial beauty attack! He didn’t believe it!!!
As a result, fans noticed that Tan Zhi Yu was super dedicated recently! Wherever he went, he was reading scripts!! So professional!
In reality: obsessively posting on forums [Why is my wife not interested in me] frantically buying “How to Attract an Alpha” and “Small Details Omegas Love” guides, and secrets for seduction.
In practice, every time Boss Xing returned home after being marked, enduring back pain, he fell into deep confusion—did he do something to offend him?
Why did he always have the feeling he was about to be killed in bed? Does combining with him make him this repulsed?
It seems he needs to get a divorce sooner rather than later; he clearly hates me.
Next door, due to the omega leaving once again without looking back after pulling up his pants, Tan Mei Ren buried his head in the covers: “Waaahh—he has no interest in me at all!! Waaahh, what should I do—”
A year later, Boss Xing finally found the right inhibitors and prepared the divorce papers.
Facing each other, Boss Xing said, “I’m sorry it took so long to finalize the divorce.”
He thought the Alpha would be relieved, but unexpectedly, the man who usually despised him to the core lowered his head, red-eyed, tugging at his suit sleeve: “Could we… not get divorced?”
Xing Yang: “?”
“If you’re really unhappy, how about you be the top? Please don’t leave me QAQ”
Boss Xing, rubbing his waist: “?”

拜托，我和老婆契合百分！

86939.synopsis:
At thirty years old, Ruan Bochen’s life had been devoid of major upheavals, great sorrows, or joys. Naturally, he hadn’t achieved any profound understanding of life. He was just one of the countless ordinary people in this world, as insignificant as dust, living a dull life, making a living without much enthusiasm, and merely passing the days.
One day, a mixed-race teenager with light brown hair and amber eyes suddenly barged into his life. Ruan Bochen was forced to take him in, and gradually, this boy changed his life forever.
At first, Mu Yinuo was willful and unruly, bristling with thorns, and wore a cold expression towards everyone. As they grew closer, Ruan Bochen began to feel that the boy seemed like a different person in private.
He wanted to hold hands while walking, needed someone to feed him water, demanded hugs upon waking, and wanted to be carried when tired… Ruan Bochen indulged the young master’s every whim until one morning, Mu Yinuo leaned down and kissed his face.
Ruan Bochen: …This is a bit overwhelming.
One was reckless, the other cautious. Conflict erupted, and Mu Yinuo left. Ruan Bochen, carrying his regrets, fulfilled the promises he had once made to him. When they met again, his boy had already grown up.
Mu Yinuo: “Mr. Ruan, you don’t have to be so good to me.”
Ruan Bochen: “Be good, don’t worry about me.”
The restraint and rationality of an adult are no match for the sincere heart of a young person.
[Quirky, possessive, wealthy young master and top student CEO (shou) X Initially aimless, later diligent, nurturing old cadre photographer (gong)] 
Description:
Older gong, warm and healing, 1v1, HE.
[Warning] : The age difference between the gong and shou is twelve years (30/18).
[Warning] : This story includes a side couple, but they don’t have much screen time.

Simple and straightforward romance, light-hearted, easy to pick up and put down without causing distress.

87195.synopsis:
[Beloved by All + Reforming Villains + Sect Management]
Chu Sang awoke to find herself transmigrated into a cliché cultivation novel as a disposable side character, serving as a foil to the universally adored junior sister. To survive, she fled in the dead of night to the lowest-ranked sect, only to discover her new home was… rather peculiar.
The senior brother? A fallen swordsman genius, now a lovesick mess everyone pushed around. The third brother? A crippled beauty rumored to make puppets from living people. And the fourth brother? An abandoned half-demon, hopelessly in love with the heroine and doomed to die by the righteous male lead’s sword.
Great… she’d stumbled into a den of villains! The entire sect was either crazy or a total pushover!
Chu Sang glanced at the [I’m a Good Person · Attribute Points Panel] in her mind. Well, wasn’t this right up her alley?
“Senior Brother,” she said earnestly, “ever heard the saying ‘With no woman in your heart, your sword naturally becomes divine’?”
“…” That… actually made sense?
[Senior Brother’s Corruption Value -1, Host gains +1 Random Attribute Point!]
[Point allocated successfully, Aptitude: 1]
“Third Brother, fear not! I know where to find medicine for your legs. Let’s grab it first and outdo them all!”
[Point allocated successfully, Comprehension: 10]
“Fourth Brother, why are you so timid? As a human-demon hybrid, you could dominate both realms! Your father’s about to ascend – seize this chance to build your empire!”
[Point allocated successfully, Luck: 100]
From that day forward, the senior brothers reformed, striving to be upright cultivators. Meanwhile, their seemingly gentle junior sister effortlessly dispatched the male and female leads.
The brothers were baffled. “Weren’t we supposed to be the good guys now?”
And how on earth was their junior sister so strong when she slacked off every day?
associated_names: 全宗上下皆反派, 卷王师妹杀穿天

90011.synopsis:
In the MMORPG ‘Tower of Avalon,’
I, who possessed a necromancer vampire, was betrayed and schemed against by the protagonist’s party.
Deceived by their lies, I was bound in iron chains and sealed in the deepest, lightless dungeon for an eternity.
After a millennium of gnashing my teeth in anger and betrayal,
On the thousandth year, the seal was finally broken.
Now, all that remains for me is an overwhelming desire for revenge.

92059.synopsis:
Weak abilities? No problem! A teacher with unmatched swordsmanship dominates a fantasy world with nothing but his blade!
–[The Strongest Rankings] 
In this world, people’s strength is ranked by a system, and high school teacher Shigeto Kusunoki found himself transported there along with his students.
While his students gained overpowered abilities, Shigeto’s powers were weak, and his rank was among the lowest. Ridiculed by his students, Shigeto tried to adapt to this new world, supported by a priestess named Mirei. But then, one of his students, Yuzuki Kimishima, was sent to a monster-filled ruin from which no one had ever returned.
Determined to save his student, Shigeto set off alone into the deadly ruins to rescue Yuzuki.
In the depths of despair, his one remaining weapon, the swordsmanship he had honed before being transported, held an extraordinary power in this world.
“You’re sacrificing yourself for me… I… I…” Yuzuki, who admired him, could only watch as Shigeto fought on, cutting down enemies to protect her.
As he continued to fight, Shigeto’s rank soared to unimaginable heights, and soon his name began to spread throughout the world.
–This is the story of how a mere side-character teacher dominated a fantasy world with nothing but his sword and became a Sword Saint.
associated_names: In a World Where Strength Is Ranked, I, a High School Teacher, Was Transported Along With My Students and Rose From a Mere Side Character to the Rank of Sword Saint  (Light Novel)

92571.synopsis:
One day, Jackson Carter, a seasoned hunter, is tasked with a mission: assassinate the Queen of Arachron.
A few weeks after beheading the queen, Jackson wakes up in the banquet hall of Arachron, dressed in an elegant gown.
[Do you, human Jackson Carter, agree to marry King Calint Lakron  and become the Queen of Arachron?] 
Stunned and confused, Jackson glanced at the large figure meant to be his groom. He had a chiseled jawline, a sharp nose, and an impressive chest. From the waist up, he looked no different from a well-built man. But his lower body… it was a grotesque fusion of spider and scorpion.
Sensing his impending doom, Jackson squeezed his eyes shut, thinking, So this is it. I’m going to die, executed by a monster. Just when I thought my wretched, miserable life might finally take a turn for the better.
Thus begins the tumultuous journey of Jackson Carter, once a human assassin, now navigating life in the Kingdom of Arachron!

98203.synopsis:
Jiang Jingchun, who was the cherished daughter of a minister’s household, grew up as a true pampered young miss. She could have whatever she desired, except for one thing: her cousin, Gu Huaisheng, the young marquis from the marquis’ residence.
Gu Huaisheng, who was the son of a marquis’ household, was like snow on the eaves or the moon outside the window—elegant, untouchable, and the most outstanding young man in his family. He was far beyond anyone’s reach.
Jiang Jingchun tried everything to win his favour. She learned the type of person he seemed to admired and transformed herself from an outspoken and willful young lady into someone obedient and meek in his presence.
Yet no matter how hard she tried, Gu Huaisheng would barely spare her a glance.
The frustrated and desperate Jiang Jingchun followed a terrible idea from her closest friend. One day, while he wasn’t paying attention, she leaned in to kiss his cheek. But just as she moved closer, Gu Huaisheng turned his head, and their lips accidentally met…
The soft touch of their lips startled her, but before Jiang Jingchun could even blush, Gu Huaisheng shoved her away harshly. With a cold and angry glare, he spat, “Shameless,” and strode away without a backward glance.
That one push left Jiang Jingchun completely stunned and shattered her girlish infatuation into pieces.
*
Misfortunes never come singly. At the same time, news arrived at the minister’s household: the true daughter of their family had been found.
Jiang Jingchun had lived as the family’s treasured daughter for over a decade. Only then did she learn that she was, in fact, a fake daughter.
At the true daughter’s formal recognition banquet, Jiang Jingchun witnessed something that cut deeper than anything before. The Gu Huaisheng who had always been cold and distant to her now stood before the true daughter and treated her gently and warmly.
He could smile, she realised, but not for her.
From beginning to end, she had been nothing but a colossal joke.
Gu Huaisheng was cruel. She swore she would never like him again.
*
After the true daughter returned, Jiang Jingchun’s heart turned to ashes. She calmly accepted the marriage that the Jiang family arranged for her.
But before the betrothal was finalised, Gu Huaisheng appeared at her family residence’s doorstep.
On a day of heavy rain, he stood in the downpour under an umbrella, gripping her delicate wrist and refusing to let go. He said, “He is not a good man.”
Jiang Jingchun laughed and shook off his hand. “He is still far kinder than you, Cousin.”
Under Jiang Jingchun’s icy gaze, Gu Huaisheng tensed up as a sharp ache spread through his chest.
For the first time, the proud and aloof young marquis understood what it truly meant to feel regret.

99739.synopsis:
“I just pretended to be friendly with you for my parents’ sake, but I don’t like you at all.”
“In the first place, you should do something about that ungainly hairstyle and glasses. Your body is also small… did you really think you could match me? In fact, I don’t like it, lol.”
Spring of third year of high school.
Inoshita Rikuto was dumped by his childhood friend of ten years.
In an effort to forget the shock of losing his love, he cuts his long bangs, stops wearing glasses and wears contacts, and quickly becomes the talk of the town!
“Ri, Rikuto, if it’s okay with you, I’ll go out with you after all, okay?”
After a while, his childhood friend says something absurd, but it’s too late.
Rikuto had already made friends with the school’s idol, a junior girl, and a beautiful girl.

100507.synopsis:
After dying under an overturned truck and opening his eyes, Latian finds himself in the world of a fantasy novel he had read during his life.
 To avoid immediate death, he betrays his allies and follows the protagonist of this world, Claude. 
At first, he thought he would escape once Claude’s distrust of him, suspecting him as a spy, was cleared…
“How much I love you, brother!”
In trying to avoid the immediate crisis, he ended up falling for Claude.

“…”

Before he knew it, Latian found himself in a relationship where he only shared his body with Claude. 
That alone might have been enough.
But soon, Latian began to feel genuine affection for him.
“I’m planning to leave the North.”
Love that will go unreciprocated… Let’s end it now.

100763.synopsis:
One day, three slightly older men are suddenly summoned to another world.

However, the three who were summoned all fail, which is a ridiculous result, and the one who led the summoning is furious.
They are thrown out of the castle.
Still, in order to survive, they take up a job called “Walker”.
Awaiting them are mountains, forests, and jungles.
They are attacked by creatures that are similar to boars, deer, and wolves, which are called magical beasts.
And the three are forced to live a life of survival.
To earn money, to eat, and to live.
The three fools hunt again today.

They are neither heroes nor the protagonists of a fairy tale.
That is why they do not bring about changes that will change the world.
However, no matter where
If you’re alive, you get hungry.

In the forest of another world, they put their hands together and say “Itadakimasu” (thank you for the meal).

Steak! Fried chicken! Salt-grilled river fish! Rice and vegetables!
No special dishes are needed.

Yazawa Hiro had a cute childhood friend whom he had been in love with ever since he was little. However, one day he witnesses she was confessed to by another man, and his heart is indirectly broken. Hiro, who did not want to face his childhood friend, changed his behavior, and as a result, he became friends with a junior, Kido Tsumugi, a tall beautiful girl with silver hair.
“Matsuyuki san is an evil woman who deceives men.”

Hiro hears a bad rumor about the two.
A youthful romantic comedy that begins with a sense of defeat.

102299.synopsis: Lu Ran had long since known that his path in life differed from others when he awakened a special ability one day. Sure enough a mysterious black card appeared, giving him the chance to become a beastmaster. With his loyal husky by his side, he sets out on his path to greatness.

104091.synopsis:
Good news: I’ve been reincarnated! And I even have a powerful master to guide me!
Bad news: My master abandoned my sect’s matriarch when I was ten years old and ran off. Now it’s just me holding the sect together by sheer willpower.
Good news: A self-proclaimed “Number One Beauty in the World” has suddenly shown up as my junior sister without invitation!
Bad news: I was born blind—I can’t see anything.
Good news: One day, out of nowhere, I regain my sight!
Bad news: Something feels… off about my junior sister. And the matriarch too… Everyone seems strange!
…
When corruption and evil surged across the Five Continents, the five divine mountains stood tall, shielding the mortal realm from chaos.

106395.synopsis:
Exaggerated tales of adventure to seduce a widow,
A quest used as an excuse to leave abruptly,
The journey toward the Demon King’s castle is filled with affection and desire.

114843.synopsis:
The apocalypse has arrived. As society’s order steadily crumbles, Wu Heng watches helplessly as everyone around him dies one by one. Meanwhile, a few lucky survivors begin to awaken supernatural abilities.
But he remains the same—ordinary and unremarkable, just like he was back in school.
Wu Heng hides at home with his parents and younger sister, too afraid to venture outside.
Food runs out quickly, and late at night, Wu Heng overhears his parents discussing whether to eat his sister first or himself first.
Wu Heng quietly pushes open the master bedroom door, “Mom, I’m hungry. Can I have a bite of you first?”
—
Wu Heng leaves home with his sister and joins the large group of classmates.
His sister notices that their classmates are very cold toward them. They seem to think Wu Heng is just a powerless loser.

He can even tear ghosts apart and chew them up.
—
Several classmates mysteriously disappear. After roll call, the class monitor confronts Wu Heng:

122011.synopsis:
Before the imperial edict for marriage arrived, I never imagined that my husband-to-be would be Xue Shaochong.
Although we practically grew up together—studying and playing in the palace—we were childhood acquaintances at best.
But we never opened our hearts to each other, nor truly understood one another. We got along well enough when we played.

Meanwhile, my aunt, by sheer family power, has held her place in the Central Palace despite never bearing a child.
His mother is Princess Dai Zhan of Xiliang—iron-willed and unyielding.

? Everyone is morally gray

? Romance is not glorified.

135323.synopsis:
Su Xu transmigrated straight into an ABO novel, clutching the script of a certified evil side character. Beautiful face? Yes. High-quality pheromones? Absolutely not. What he had instead was a knock-off, low-grade scent that basically screamed: “Please bully me!”
And according to the plot, his glorious future was:
→ Pretty but useless Omega.
→ Tossed into a den of wolves (not the cute fluffy kind, the scary kind).
→ Reduced to a plaything for everyone.

Determined not to let himself be dog food for the plot, Su Xu made a vow:

The “ex-boyfriend” who dumped him turned pirate, only to come back awkwardly offering an olive branch.
And to top it off, even the prince of an enemy nation traveled across the stars, sneaking around just to meet him in secret.

S-Class Guide Eunmyeong died after being caught in the rampage of an Esper.

Eunmyeong, somehow, ends up guiding the patients lying around,
 and soon realizes that the inner energy (naegong) of this world functions similarly to the Esper waves from his own.
“Do you still not understand? You are a living elixir.”
 “What did you do to me?”
